sources.quoted_phrase: To prevent, deter and detect crime through excellence in investigation.

content.mission: Prevent, deter and detect crime through excellence in investigation; the Major Crime Division investigates homicide, kidnapping, firearm offences and bomb and explosive-related offences.

sequence.label: Investigate
sequence.action: Investigate the major offences of the incident (homicide, kidnapping, firearm, bomb and explosive-related) through the Major Crime Division; follow the agency's standard operating procedure.

sequence.label: Intelligence
sequence.action: Collect, analyse and disseminate criminal intelligence in support of the investigation.
